title: Weird dream
content: I was in this gothic style hotel with my mom and we had to stay the night there. It was time to go to sleep and the room had two beds and just one room with a big window to the far side of the room away from the door. My mom was gonna sleep in the bed closest to door. For more detail the room had red walls with black baseboards and red velvet drapes and the whole Devore felt like 1980s that had been renovated. It was time to sleep so I went to go lock the door. To my surprise I could lock the door at all so I was sure I wouldn’t sleep until this door locked . It finally ended up locking and as soon as it did the door started to open from the hinge side…. So now the whole door falls off and I tell my mom we need to go speak to the manager . She went to go downstairs to speak with the manager and I started to become very lucid and followed her. When I went into the hallway I passed by a very strange looking man almost resembling the penguin from Batman. I got to the elevator room and saw a lady and asked how to use the elevator. She pointed to a sink that had a green light eminating from it and she told me to go in. I was hesitant but I ended up doing it. It was very strange sensation goin thru it and I went in head first . I ended up landing in some type of janitor room in a mall. When I opened the door I was in a mall and every single Person in the mall was mentally handicapped in the sense they would all doing something very unatrual. Like the. Server was smashing hotdogs and I confronted him but no real response I tried to find a normal person but couldn’t and then woke up and had the same dream twice but this time with another person
